daily_kpi: The 2026-11-28 UTC minimum was already met by the separate MEXC funding-dispersion / BTC realized-variance backtest #46085887442; this H.8 study is additional research.
data_scope: ALFRED H.8 TOTCI 484 Sunday as-of vintages from 2017-08-20 to 2026-11-22; Binance BTCUSDT Spot 1d UTC 2017-08-17 to 2026-11-25 (3388 candles, 136 manifest-matched archives); weekly Sunday events; validation 2019-2021; test 2022 onward

ALFRED.provider: Federal Reserve Board H.8 via ALFRED
ALFRED.series_title: Commercial and Industrial Loans, All Commercial Banks
ALFRED.units: billions of U.S. dollars, seasonally adjusted

BTCUSDT.provider: Binance Vision official Spot monthly/daily 1d kline archives
BTCUSDT.rehydration_note: The accepted source manifest records archive hashes but the prior run did not retain raw daily rows. The exact same 136 official archives were re-materialized and every archive/checksum/coverage field was required to match the accepted manifest; no alternate source or date extension was used.

disposition: INCONCLUSIVE — evidence is mixed, statistically uncertain or insufficient under the frozen rule

event_construction.event_frequency: Sunday UTC; five-session Monday-Friday target; no overlap

limitations: ALFRED vintage dates have day-level, not intraday, resolution; the Sunday convention follows the scheduled Friday H.8 release and rejects stale vintages, but it does not prove exact intraday first-publication time.
TOTCI is a seasonally adjusted aggregate and may be revised; the model uses the exact Sunday vintage rather than today's current-vintage FRED series.
C&I loan growth mixes credit supply and credit demand and is not an identified exogenous lending shock.
BTCUSDT is one venue's Spot close; archive checksums establish file integrity, not consolidated exchange-independent prices.

The accepted prior BTC run retained the archive manifest but not raw daily rows; the same 136 official archives were re-materialized and every archive hash, checksum hash, date and row count was matched to that manifest.
This is a forecast-only screen, not causal identification, trading P&L, profitability, a strategy promotion or live deployment evidence.
The result is one exploratory hypothesis among many; nominal bootstrap intervals do not adjust for repository-wide multiple testing or selection bias.

methodology.event_frequency: weekly Sunday UTC; target Monday-Friday; no overlap
methodology.point_in_time: One ALFRED as-of vintage per Sunday signal; latest observation must be Wednesday and 3-14 days old; four prior weekly observations must have 5-9 day spacing; invalid vintages are excluded
methodology.predictor: 100 * ln(TOTCI latest available in the Sunday vintage / fourth prior weekly observation in the same vintage)
methodology.target: log1p(mean(min(next-five UTC daily BTC log return, 0)^2) * 10000)
methodology.training_rule: latest 104 prior events with both signal date and five-session target end strictly before the current Sunday signal
